content: धनम् [धन्-अच्] .²1 Property, wealth, riches, treasure, money (gold, chattels <ab>&c.</ab>); धनं तावदसुलभम् <ls>H. 1</ls>; (<ab>fig.</ab> also) as in तपोधन, विद्याधन, <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 .³({%a%}) Any valued possession, an object of affection or endearment, dearest treasure; कष्टं जनः कुलधनैरनुरञ्जनीयः <ls>U. 1. 14</ls>; गुरोरपीदं धनमाहिताग्नेः <ls>R. 2. 44</ls>; मानधन, अभिमान˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .³({%b%}) A valuable article; <ls>Ms. 8. 201</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 8.">202</ls>. .²3 Capital (<ab>opp.</ab> वृद्धि or interest). .²4 A booty, prey, spoil. .²5 The reward given to a victor in a combat, the prize won in a game. .²6 A contest for prizes, a match. .²7 The lunar mansion called धनिष्ठा. .²8 Surplus, residue. .²9 (In <ab>math.</ab>) The affirmative quantity or plus (<ab>opp.</ab> ऋण). .²10 A sound.
